description: Per-component coverage exemptions for the HELiX library. The target threshold is 95% (raised from 80% as part of the test expansion initiative). Components listed here are exempt from the CI coverage gate during the remediation period. Each exemption must include a remediation target date. New or modified components are NOT eligible for exemption.

hx-alert.reason: SSR browser API guards added — coverage below threshold. Requires test expansion.

hx-banner.reason: SSR browser API guards added — coverage below threshold. Requires test expansion.
